name: Yuvraj Pratap Singh
shortBio: Leads creative direction and production planning, helping shape projects from concept through execution.
details: Works across direction and producing, connecting creative intent with practical production planning. His focus is keeping a project aligned from early development through shoot execution and final delivery.

name: Aditya Mehta
shortBio: Works across direction and writing, developing story ideas into clear narratives for screen.
details: Works at the intersection of writing and direction, shaping narrative structure, character and screen language. His role supports translating written ideas into clear, production-ready storytelling.

name: Alex
shortBio: Shapes cinematography, camera language and visual execution to support the mood and story of each production.
details: Leads visual storytelling through cinematography, framing, camera movement and lighting choices. He works closely with direction and lighting teams to maintain a consistent visual language from setup to final frame.

name: Devendra Singh
shortBio: Contributes both on screen and behind the scenes, supporting production coordination and performance requirements.
details: Supports projects from both production and performance perspectives. His role bridges practical production needs with an actor's understanding of on-screen execution and collaboration.

name: Ravinder Singh
shortBio: Supports production planning, resources and execution so projects can move smoothly from preparation to delivery.
details: Focuses on production support, coordination and resource planning. He helps keep schedules, logistics and day-to-day production requirements moving in sync with the creative plan.

name: Shivam Chaudhary
shortBio: Oversees production workflows and coordination, keeping teams, schedules and project requirements aligned.
details: Coordinates production workflows across teams, schedules and day-to-day execution. His focus is creating a clear operating rhythm so creative and technical teams can concentrate on delivering the work.

name: Rahul Rasimo
shortBio: Works across executive production and direction, supporting creative decisions and overall project delivery.
details: Combines executive production oversight with directorial input, helping balance creative priorities with practical project needs. His role supports decision-making across development and execution.

name: Akash
shortBio: Shapes the visual world of productions through art direction, sets, props and design coordination.
details: Develops the physical visual language of a production through set ideas, props, textures and art coordination. His work helps ensure the world in front of the camera supports the tone of the story.

name: Shailesh Singh
shortBio: Contributes to the musical identity of projects through music production and vocal performance.
details: Works on the musical side of productions, supporting composition, production and vocal performance. His focus is helping music feel connected to the emotion and identity of the visual story.

name: Deepak Arya
shortBio: Handles digital intermediate and color finishing, helping create a consistent and polished final visual tone.
details: Focuses on color finishing and visual consistency in post-production. His work helps balance shots, refine mood and bring the final image closer to the intended cinematic look.

name: Pradeep Yadav
shortBio: Supports casting requirements by identifying and coordinating suitable talent for production roles.
details: Works with the creative and production teams to understand character requirements, identify suitable performers and coordinate the casting process from outreach through selection.

name: Mrityunjaya
shortBio: Works with camera and lighting teams to execute dependable lighting setups safely and consistently on set.
details: Supports the cinematography team through practical lighting execution, fixture placement and on-set adjustments. His role helps translate the lighting plan into a controlled shooting environment.

name: Mamvijay
shortBio: Contributes vocal performance to music-led and creative productions when the project calls for it.
details: Supports music-led productions with vocal performance and interpretation. The focus is on delivering vocals that fit the emotion, style and storytelling requirements of the project.

name: Sharad Chand Upadhyay
shortBio: Works across anchoring and voice-over, bringing clear delivery and vocal presence to screen and audio content.
details: Contributes spoken performance across anchoring and voice-over requirements. His role focuses on clear communication, vocal expression and adapting delivery to the tone of the production.
